practice_model.elapsed: server running time only, pause gaps excluded (elapsed_source server_running_time)
refused: a session open more than 24 hours (409, cancel instead)
an asserted money/outcome target in the optional intention line (practice_outcome_target 400, nothing written)
never_refused: an empty optional intention line (means no intention)
a short or early-completed session (recorded as it happened)
an unreadable stored row (reported unavailable, never counted)

scope: M108 the regulation layer as a personal practice log: presets/custom length, elapsed-time bells with a locally generated tone (no audio asset, nothing fetched), ambience recorded as the trader own declaration (never played by this app), the toolkit text with per-item attribution, immutable receipts recorded as they happened, and a records-only progress view. The only measurable claim is elapsed server running time; nothing verifies meditation, calm, focus or any physiological/emotional/performance effect. It is personal and never desk-scoped (no account_id on any route), it has no score/percentage/adherence/gate/permission and no authority over entries/signals/risk/cap/routine/core/grades/history, and M64 routine/M106 gate/M107 intention stay separate. M30/M103 partial; M109/M110/M111/M112 TODO. No70%/causal/predictive/provider/broker/human/mental-state/actual-meditation/pixel/production proof.
